  {"step":2,"file":"jdcoefct.c","function":"start_output_pass","line":64,"var":"cinfo->coef->decompress_data","code":"if (cinfo->do_block_smoothing && smoothing_ok(cinfo)) coef->pub.decompress_data = decompress_smooth_data;","note":"When smoothing is allowed, the coefficient controller switches the output callback to decompress_smooth_data."},
  {"step":3,"file":"jdcoefct.c","function":"smoothing_ok","line":359,"var":"cinfo->coef_bits[ci]","code":"coef_bits = cinfo->coef_bits[ci]; prev_coef_bits = cinfo->coef_bits[ci + cinfo->num_components];","note":"The smoothing gate latches per-component coefficient state from the progressive JPEG input, including AC/DC accuracy metadata."},
  {"step":4,"file":"jdcoefct.c","function":"decompress_smooth_data","line":426,"var":"cinfo->inputctl->consume_input","code":"while (cinfo->input_scan_number <= cinfo->output_scan_number && !cinfo->inputctl->eoi_reached) { ... if ((*cinfo->inputctl->consume_input)(cinfo) == JPEG_SUSPENDED) return JPEG_SUSPENDED; }","note":"The smoothing routine may advance input scans until the current output scan is ready, so it can operate on partially refined progressive data."},
  {"step":5,"file":"jdcoefct.c","function":"decompress_smooth_data","line":513,"var":"coef_bits","code":"if (cinfo->output_iMCU_row > cinfo->master->last_good_iMCU_row) coef_bits = coef->coef_bits_latch + ((ci + cinfo->num_components) * SAVED_COEFS); else coef_bits = coef->coef_bits_latch + (ci * SAVED_COEFS);","note":"The routine selects either current or previous latched coefficient-accuracy metadata depending on how far input has progressed."},
  {"step":6,"file":"jdcoefct.c","function":"decompress_smooth_data","line":580,"var":"workspace","code":"jcopy_block_row(buffer_ptr, (JBLOCKROW)workspace, (JDIMENSION)1);","note":"Each DCT block is copied into a writable workspace so the smoothing code can estimate missing coefficients."},
  {"step":7,"file":"jdcoefct.c","function":"decompress_smooth_data","line":590,"var":"workspace[1]","code":"if ((Al = coef_bits[1]) != 0 && workspace[1] == 0) { ... pred = ...;","note":"The bug is that smoothing reads coefficient slots from the workspace before they are fully initialized for the current block, so MSan reports a use-of-uninitialized-value when the prediction logic consumes those bytes."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('wrote trace')
